label: The End of This Story: B

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Doesn't this thing ever get tired?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's taken one heck of a beating, yet it's still making such intense vibrations!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: The core is certainly holding up better than we expected... It isn't breaking apart like we thought it would.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Maybe the core has gotten weak and there's not enough energy reaching the crystals?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: If only we could throw some kind of bait to make the core expand and the crystals grow larger...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh, you mean the AA Pillar!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh right! I totally forgot about that thing.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Since it's already been melted by the silver liquid, it should be absorbed quickly.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If we feed that to the core, the crystals should grow much larger.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Well then, let's get this thing to open wide

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: so you can feed it a little treat!
Mori fires a barrage of bullets at Gluttony's battered body.
Its tentacles try to burrow into the ground to avoid the bullets...
But Yuni grabs ahold of them, preventing the beast from retreating underground.
Mihara swings her whip toward Gluttony,
and lodges the pendulum firmly into its body.
Gluttony spews silver liquid into the air.
As Little Mermaid whispers, an array of bubbles expand and shield the group.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Don't you dare go around spewing such dangerous stuff!
Chain patterns appear on Mihara and Gluttony's body and begin to glow.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Shall we have another go at it together?
Mihara bites down on the inside of her cheek.
For a brief moment, Gluttony freezes as if unable to withstand the pain.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You want this pillar so badly? Come and get it!
As Little Mermaid stretches her arms,
bubbles brimming with the AA Pillar's energy bloom in the air.
In a desperate fit, Gluttony opens its mouth wide,
and lunges toward Little Mermaid, its colossal body scraping against the ground.
and the bubbles all fly towards Gluttony's core.
The silver liquid within the bubbles seeps into Gluttony's core.
The E2 Crystals absorb the energy surging forth from the core, causing them to rapidly expand.
The crystals that filled its mouth shatter as well.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I think it's... Gluttony's main body.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wait, you're telling me there's more to this thing?!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: No wonder I sensed something more when I exchanged senses with it...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That must have been the connection to its main body.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're right. When I was inside its throat, I used the bubbles to investigate.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Gluttony consists of one massive main body, with multiple mouths attached to it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The place where I was staying was inside the throat of one of those mouth organs.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So, the core we just destroyed is the core of that mouth?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So that's why you kept saying

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: we were inside its throat, and not its stomach.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: How can you still laugh at a time like this?!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What are we gonna do if that thing comes back?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Judging by how faint those sounds are,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: it seems to have run away.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So it severed one of its mouths and fled?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It most likely ran away because its main body was about to be swallowed by the crystal.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Heh, nice to know we had it against the ropes.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Considering how it ran off with its tail tucked between its legs, I doubt it'll be back anytime soon.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It knows that this place is filled with its worst nightmare.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How does it feel to be back in the great outdoors after so long?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh yeah, that's a good point.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I guess it has been a long time for you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's been a really long time...
Little Mermaid looks up at the sky.
Instead of the familiar underwater scenery,
a real sky comes into view.
Beyond the horizon, the sun slowly ascends,
bathing the surroundings in a golden light.
Tears flow from Little Mermaid's eyes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I never thought I'd be able to see the sun again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: To be able to set my feet on solid ground, breathe in fresh air...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I didn't even dare dream of it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: For not giving up on me.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: For extending your hands out to me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: If you do... I'll... *sob*... I'll start crying too!
Mori covers her face with her hands.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Do you have any idea how worried I was?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Don't you ever do that again!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No more heroic sacrifices or any of that nonsense!
a flustered Little Mermaid consoles Mori, who is wiping away tears.
Meanwhile, Yuni simply gazes at the moving scene before her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How does it feel saving someone for the first time?
Yuni looks at her battered arms,
then at Mori and Little Mermaid, who are laughing together.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Haha, if you feel good, then so do I.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All right, you two. That's enough moving around now...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That girl... isn't that one of your bubbles, Siren?
Everyone looks in the direction Mihara is pointing
and sees a girl with long pigtails made of purplish bubbles.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Those are the bubbles I sent to find Cinderella!
Little Mermaid reaches out toward the girl,
but the bubbles disperse and eventually dissipate.
